interpretation.surface_home: At least one emitted lexical reading or structural entry; may carry no settled cells.
interpretation.signed_evidence: At least one +1 or -1 cell, including a typed head; not a complete definition.
interpretation.head_coordinate_zero: A written zero on one of the eight head coordinates; a positional count, not a new warrant.
interpretation.complete_coordinate_profile: Every coordinate settled in one emitted reading; no claim that all meanings are present or correct.
interpretation.conflict_policy: Conflicted readings remain diagnostic and may have a surface home; their cells never support evidence or coordinate-completion coverage.
interpretation.threshold_scope: Each token-mass metric is tested separately; 90% surface coverage does not certify semantic completion.
interpretation.token_policy: Unicode letter sequences with internal apostrophes/hyphens; NFC+casefold; no stemming, lemmatization, alias credit or inferred senses. Brown POS suffixes are removed first. Punctuation and numeric-only tokens are excluded; Gutenberg headers already removed by the corpus distributor.
